title: [review] add end-to-end test: signed non-canonical generalized /64 installs the masked (canonical) form
description: P3, wave-6 review. Gate-level non-canonical acceptance is tested (dao_prefix_authorization.rs:508-518) and canonicalization is provably consistent by construction (gate routing.rs:797 and extraction routing.rs:1500 apply the same pure mask_prefix_bits to the same signed bytes), but no test drives a SIGNED non-canonical /64 (host bits set beyond prefix) through process_signature_verified and asserts the installed route is masked. Add one to pin the signature-covers-non-canonical -> install-canonical property end to end.
